thread:
lee: FYI vendor portal just sent an updated manifest that created duplicate reservations for APAC Dedicated pool (two different SKUs mapping to same capacity slot). ticket VP-2198
ana: Ugh. Which SKUs?
tam: Looks like `p3e-gpu-80-A` and `p3e-gpu-80_v2` both landed as active reservations for the same rack batches. vendor CSV uses different naming conventions.
miguel: That's going to overcommit our capacity meter and also confuse billing. We might bill customers twice if we don't reconcile.
vendor-bot: [notice] Manifest VP-2198 received 2026-03-01T01:12:02Z (file: vp2198_manifest.csv)
lee: Initial thought: canonicalize to `p3e-gpu-80` in our inventory and convert duplicates into marketplace credit lines for affected customers.
nana: Can we hold off on canonicalization until we confirm which customer commits are tied to those specific reservation ids? I want to avoid moving reserved capacity under active customer claims.
tam: Good call. Proposed steps: 1) freeze new claims for `*p3e-gpu-80*` patterns (marketplace side), 2) run a mapping pass to join sku aliases to canonical id but do not alter reservations yet, 3) produce a delta report correlating reservation ids -> customer commits, 4) then apply credits or reservation adjustments.
miguel: Who owns the crediting flow? Finance + partners ops. We need a line item to compensate for any temporary availability hiccup.
lee: I'll coordinate with finance. Immediate ask for eng: a dry-run mapping job and a short report that includes counts and list of affected customer commit ids.
nana: I can draft the partner note. Short and to the point: "We're reconciling SKU aliases that caused duplicate reservations in APAC Dedicated; we've paused claiming of these SKUs and will post reconciliation results and next steps in 2 hours."
ops-bot: [alert] Pause placed on marketplace claims for pattern `p3e-gpu-80*` by lee at 2026-03-01T01:25:10Z
tam: Running dry-run now: `./tools/sku_alias_check --manifest vp2198_manifest.csv --canonical p3e-gpu-80 --dry-run`
miguel: Add `--include-commit-lookup` flag so we can map to customer commit ids.
tam: Good call. Re-running with flag.
lee: ETA for dry-run results?
tam: ~8m. Posting summary when done.
vendor-bot: [info] Vendor submitted correction note: "suffix `_v2` denotes newer firmware pack, same physical SKU."
nana: So vendor acknowledges aliasing. We still need to decide crediting policy for customers who may have attempted to claim and gotten stuck.
miguel: Finance preference: try to reconcile reservations first and only issue credits if we detect failed provisioning or double-billing. Credits should be tokenized as marketplace credits, not refunds, unless legal requests otherwise.
lee: Legal loop: @legal-team can you confirm marketplace crediting ok for APAC contracts?
nana: I'll cc legal in the partner note.
tam: Dry-run done. Short summary: manifest entries total 64 units across both SKUs, our active reservations show 62 canonical + 2 under `_v2` alias. Customer commit lookup: 5 commits reference `_v2` reservations (all in pilot stage), none are in active provisioning. Full CSV uploaded to /shared/partnerships/recon/vp2198_summary_3332106789.csv
ops-bot: [info] File uploaded: /shared/partnerships/recon/vp2198_summary_3332106789.csv by tam
miguel: Looks low-impact. If pilot commits only, we can canonicalize and convert `_v2` reservations into canonical reservations without crediting. But we should notify pilot customers proactively.
nana: Draft partner note: "We canonicalized alias SKUs to `p3e-gpu-80` and updated reservations. Pilots will see their reserved IDs preserved; partners with `_v2` reservations do not need to take action. If you observed provisioning failures, contact support with manifest ref VP-2198." Approve?
lee: Approve with small addition: include timeframe and link to recon CSV.
miguel: Finance: OK with no credits unless rollback needed. Please keep audit trail for any future invoicing adjustments.
legal-team: (joined) Confirmed: marketplace credits are default remediation. For pilot customers with specific contract clauses, escalate to legal.
lee: Performing canonicalization now as a transactional change with audit log. Command: `POST /inventory/v1/canonicalize` body `{ "from_patterns": ["p3e-gpu-80*"], "to": "p3e-gpu-80", "dry_run": false }` (audit-only flag on).
tam: Watchlist: track any 409 conflict responses from reservation service. I have a rollback script `ops/revert_canonical_vp2198.sh` ready.
ops-bot: [info] Canonicalization job started by lee at 2026-03-01T02:04:12Z
lee: Canonicalization succeeded. 2 `_v2` reservations merged into canonical; reservation counts net unchanged (64). No live provisioning failures observed.
miguel: Verified billing snapshot shows no double-charge signatures. We'll keep the transaction logs for the invoice period.
nana: Partner note sent and posted to partners portal with link to CSV and support contact.
ops-bot: [info] Partners notified via portal message ID PP-98 at 2026-03-01T02:18:45Z
lee: Closing action items: (1) tam to add ingest normalizer rule to strip `_v2`/`-legacy` suffixes, (2) ops to add a nightly alias-check job, (3) finance to mark audit trail for VP-2198.
tam: Created ticket INF-7790 for normalizer, assigned to eng-ml.
miguel: Finance note created FN-4432, tagging the 2026-02 invoice window.
lee: Thanks all. If anything else pops up, re-open thread. :wave:
